tasks.goal: Use the word 'indemnity'

tasks.goal: Use the word 'exclusion'
tasks.hint: An exclusion is a specific condition or hazard not covered under an insurance policy. Ask for a complete breakdown of water damage exclusions.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'rider'
tasks.hint: A rider is a supplementary provision attached to an insurance policy adding specific benefits. Inquire about adding a jewelry rider for high-value items.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'recourse'
tasks.hint: Recourse is the legal right to seek compensation or reimbursement. Inquire about third-party recourse procedures in insurance disputes.
